THE SCENE

Your science class is on a trip to an island in Canada. In the day, white bears catch more fish than black bears. Your class wants to know if white fur is becoming more common. You keep the class notebook, and today's page needs four numbers. Four people each counted one number.

THE HISTORY

This trip is about the spirit bear, a bear with white fur. It lives on the land of the Gitga'at people in Canada. For many years, the Gitga'at kept the white bears a secret. This kept the bears safe from hunters who wanted their fur.
